unit: WF4 Distil Sources verification grading (pre-alignment version)
description: An Angular app shell (ng-version= in the raw HTML) is rejected before any text-based grading.
why_it_exists: Three verification defects were found in live WF4 runs. (1) source_type was HARDCODED to OFFICIAL for every fetched page, so a landing page, a block page or a blog was all stamped official. (2) verification_status was decided by text.length > 400 alone, so navigation chrome on a bare homepage passed as RETRIEVED and was then cited by id in a legal draft - fabricated authority, and the most dangerous defect in the build. (3) execution 300: a federal legislation page returned 1.23 MB of text with no section heading marker and was still graded RETRIEVED, because a table of contents is full of structural words. A heading-marker check now separates a real section body from an index.
